content.description: Fancy Foxes is building a game to provide holders of our Series 1 Foxes of the first 5,000 a one-of-a-kind experience. Players will be able to immerse themselves in a forest of ambiance and search for items of the fanciest nature to dress their fox. Once all objectives are completed, players will be rewarded with additional NFT drops from the project. This environment is currently under development using Unreal and Ludotoken API.
